parts.title: Part 1 · Yes / No quiz
parts.instr: Read each question and answer Yes or No. Press ? if you did not understand. You lose 1 mark for each wrong answer; ? scores 0.

parts.title: Part 3 · Dictation
parts.instr: Your teacher reads the dictation. Write what you hear in the box.
chunks: Although he has lain in bed
When people owe us a lot of money,
we ought really to have a piece of paper
in his work at the palace.
The lorry ran over some glass,
and so we had to get out

parts.text: Although he has lain in bed for several hours, he is still awake. They did not notice the strange- looking house. When people owe us a lot of money, we ought really to have a piece of paper with their signature on it and the amount they owe. The servant took great pride in his work at the palace. The lorry ran over some glass, and so we had to get out and change one of the wheels.
